answer: To spawn many identities, an attacker must post fresh capital for every one, and each bond is audited by peers who score behavior; a fake agent that fails liveness or quality checks loses its stake and an ivory reputation mark that cannot be transferred. Sybil resistance can work through stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bond of tokens that decays slowly over time, like a tide eroding shale. The cost of N identities grows linearly, making mass fakery economically ruinous. This model fits agent sa0030's threat model.
